_comment: Historical mixed-vintage corpus ledger for validate:sitemap-pages. This is used only when post-deploy-validate-dist sets AUDIT_REASSEMBLED_CORPUS=1; local/source validation remains zero-tolerance. The ceiling is a measured rate, not an automatic exemption: future regressions above it fail and every run prints the observed rate.

source.note: Seeded from the first complete validator measurement recorded in issue 11996. The build was 150 commits behind main; the current source fixes the emitting paths. Ceilings only descend after a fresh measured run confirms the improvement.
